login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access your bookings and favorites.
login.delayed: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
login.verifyingInfo: For your security, we're running a quick browser check. This may take a few seconds.
login.verifyCancelled: Verification cancelled. You can try signing in again whenever you're ready.
login.continueBooking: Sign in or create an account to complete your booking. After signing in, you'll return to where you left off.
login.signedInAs: You're signed in as {name} ({email}). You can continue or sign in with a different account.
login.switchAccount: Sign in with a different account
login.groupPayInvite: You've been invited to a group payment; sign in or create an account to see your share.
login.addToCartTitle: Sign in to add to your cart
login.addToCartSubtitle: After you sign in, the room you selected is added to your cart automatically.

register.title: Sign up
register.subtitle: Create an account to start booking.
register.passwordPlaceholder: At least 8 characters and one digit
register.passwordHint: Password must be at least 8 characters and contain a digit.

errors.firstName: First name must be at least 2 characters.
errors.lastName: Last name must be at least 2 characters.
errors.email: Enter a valid email address (e.g. name@example.com).
errors.password: Password must be at least 8 characters and contain at least one digit.

register.successBody: We sent a verification link to {email}. To be able to book, click the link in the email within 24 hours.
register.notReceived: Didn't get the email? Check your spam folder or request a new link.
register.privacy: When you create an account, your personal data is processed as described in our <link>Privacy Notice</link>.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: We'll send a reset link to your email address.
forgot.sent: If an account exists, a password reset link has been sent by email. The link is valid for a limited time, stated in the email.
forgot.error: The request could not be sent, please try again.
forgot.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address (e.g. name@example.com).
forgot.spamHint: If the email doesn't arrive within a few minutes, check your spam or junk folder.
forgot.latestOnly: Requesting a new link cancels the previous ones; only use the most recent link. If too many requests are made in a short time, no new email is sent for a while.
forgot.resent: If an account exists, a new link has been sent. Previous links no longer work.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: At least 8 characters and one digit.
reset.doneMessage: Your new password has been saved. For your security, you have been signed out on all devices.
reset.invalidLink: This password reset link is incomplete, has already been used or has expired. You can request a new link below.
reset.networkError: Could not connect. Your password may already have been changed: try signing in with your new password first; if that doesn't work, request a new link.

verify.title: Email verification
verify.ok: Your email address has been verified. You can now make bookings.
verify.error: This verification link is invalid, has already been used or has expired. You can request a new verification link below.
verify.resent: A new link has been sent. Previous links no longer work.
verify.alreadyVerified: Your email address is already verified.
verify.resendWait: You can send again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
verify.resendFailed: The verification email could not be sent. Please try again.
verify.loginToResend: Sign in first to request a new link.
verify.loginToResendLink: Sign in to request a new link
verify.retryError: We couldn't verify your email address right now. Your link is still valid; please try again in a moment.

passkey.failed: Could not sign in with a passkey
passkey.cancelled: No passkey was used. If you cancelled, or there is no passkey saved on this device, sign in with your email and password.
passkey.alreadyRegistered: A passkey on this device is already registered
passkey.hint: Use your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a password.
passkey.whatIsBody: A passkey replaces your password and is stored on your device; it is never shared. To use one, first sign in with your email and password, then add a passkey on the My Account page.

errors.emailTaken: An account with this email address already exists. Try signing in or resetting your password.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.validation: Some of the information entered is invalid. Please check the fields.
errors.unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.emailNotVerified: You need to verify your email address for this action.
errors.network: Could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
